offending_extra_words: to have modified for Sparkling's internal business purposes
and all materials, information and intellectual property provided or made available by Sparkling under this Agreement
reasons: Preferred level fails: the redline leaves Garman as owner of all IP in the Work with no assignment of deliverables or work product to Sparkling ("No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling").

The embedded-IP licence is too narrow for the preferred position: it reaches only "the Modifications and any other customisations paid for by Sparkling", not any Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables.
Fallback is also incomplete: the grant omits sublicensing, gives only a 'have modified' right rather than a right to modify, and is limited to funded Modifications rather than deliverables generally.

Not minimal for a preferred target: the insertion imports fallback-only attributes ("worldwide", modification rights) and an expansive Customer-materials ownership statement beyond what is needed to secure Customer Data rights and the embedded-IP licence.
Customer Data retention and no-assignment are properly secured, and the narrowing of Garman's ownership to materials it provides is a well-targeted edit.
